notes.title: Slime Mayhem - Mythical Weapons DLC released!
notes.content:
Slime Mayhem - Mythical Weapons DLC, where you will crush mutant slimes using the weapons of mythological gods, has been released!


https://store.steampowered.com/app/3072290/Slime_Mayhem__Mythical_Weapons/

notes.title: Slime Mayhem Will Now Be Free On Steam
notes.content: Hello, Slime Mayhem will now be free on Steam. The game will be free, but new paid DLC's will come. We are doing this to transition to the paid DLC system and to announce our game to more people. Thank you for your understanding.

notes.title: Slime Mayhem Released on Steam!
notes.content: Slime Mayhem is now released and playable on Steam! Start the slime massacre in the Slamus laboratory to destroy mutant slimes with 4 different weapons!

notes.title: Slime Mayhem, the 2024 Roguelike game, will be released on Steam on April 9!
notes.content:
Mutant slimes created by scientists in the laboratory to destroy garbage waste got out of control and started eating people! A few surviving scientists created you in a laboratory to destroy them, and you were sent on a suicide mission. Slime Mayhem will be released on Steam on April 9, add it to your wishlist now!
